items.title: Harold E. Peterson Interview, 1979-08-06
items.q: Yeah, we worked, I worked with him with, uh, with Steele. We played jobs there with Steele around 29.

ctx.x: I think between, uh, Berks and Palmyra. Now, the Six and Magazine bunch, that was the Cassards from up there.

Yes, sir. I see. Yeah, yeah. And Santo Giuffre, yeah, and he was telling me about some fella, I used to always tell him, I'd say, Father, never let them fellas put any heat on your mouthpiece. Uh-huh. And he said that he was in the jam one night, that's one day or something, he had to go and work, and he said the fella put the car and put the heat on, he said never could get any sound out of that particular mouthpiece. And he said that, he really told me that was one of the finest mouthpieces he has ever had. He…
relative on Mardi Gras Day from up around Chicago, that area. I don't remember the exact time.
